definition_order: Rules frozen before CPU deployment generation and reuse/outcome inspection

B0.name: Seed-only
B0.seed: Exact Module 8C quality-constrained empirical integer MILP seed, sourced from pre-GPU planning_preflight

B1.name: Qwen-centric + Quality Repair
B1.default: Every admitted Qwen task exclusively routes to Qwen
B1.repair: Cover remaining six-task universe with minimum-cardinality admitted Specialist set; tie-break by total frozen s0 on repaired tasks, then sorted model IDs
B1.inactive_tasks: Retain fixed deployment; zero traffic; do not remove Qwen or repairs

B2.name: Specialist-greedy + Minimal Generalist
B2.active_task_rule: Specialist argmin s0 among admitted paths; if absent, Generalist argmin s0; exact ties by model ID
B2.replicas: One replica for each distinct selected model
B2.routing: 100% task traffic to selected model; not canonical redistribution
B2.inactive_tasks: Excluded from selection; N_G=0 allowed if all active tasks have Specialist coverage

B3.name: Static Hybrid
B3.aggregate_lambda: Per-task math.fsum of six frozen lambda values divided by six; no rounding
B3.deployment: Existing quality-constrained empirical integer MILP seeder at aggregate lambda; minimum empirical memory then replica count
B3.routing: Canonical empirical LP separately for each original workload, fixed deployment
B3.inactive_tasks: Retain static deployment; no deployment pruning

B4.name: Random-neighbor + Same Runtime Budget
B4.candidate_set: Exactly the existing x±1 neighborhood and feasibility/tabu/memory/coverage/canonical-capacity filters
B4.prioritization: Existing random.Random(seed).sample(sorted(feasible,key=model),len(feasible)); first top_b; no delta_z/LP rank selection
B4.LP_allowed: Same bottleneck/neighborhood definition, feasibility and canonical routing; delta_z may be logged but not used for selection
B4.objective: Unchanged Module 3 NoiseAwareRuntimeObjective(1ms, 5%); stability first; same-steady mean then weighted task P95 then memory; same-nonsteady retains incumbent.
B4.runtime_evaluator: Existing ReplicaRuntimeEvaluator; no-VQA uses the same frozen transport-compatibility runner as Module 8C
B4.reporting: Report all three fixed RNG seeds individually and their predeclared equal-weight mean/median/range; no best-of-seeds or best-of-baselines
B4.fairness_unit: One workload × one RNG seed has exactly Proposed budget; three-seed totals are explicitly 3×, never pooled into a larger search

measurement_protocol.B0_to_B3: 3 timed repetitions + 2 independent confirmation repetitions per fixed state; no search
measurement_protocol.B4: ≤6 valid unique states including seed ×3, seed and final separately ×2 confirmations; same max_iterations/patience as Proposed
measurement_protocol.metric: Existing equal-repetition arrival-weighted mean E2E and weighted task P95; unchanged stability/objective
measurement_protocol.source_hash_gate: Recheck environments, source revisions/weights, handlers, precision/backend and all frozen inputs before any future measurement

reuse_policy.donor_selection: Required search seeds 7101/7202/7303 and confirmation seeds 8101/8202; priority source Module8C then historical, seed-role evidence before final-role evidence; lexicographic paths; never latency values
reuse_policy.correlation_reporting: Shared raw runs are one measurement, not independent additional repetitions
reuse_policy.unknown_B4_future_states: Reuse only after full exact identity check; no guessed trajectories or budget extension

quality_reporting: Task-wise routing-fraction weighted frozen audit metrics, report-only; no cross-task universal average, no runtime objective changes
